name: cartwright-template
description: Cartwright — the open-source, WebMCP-native Next.js + Stripe commerce engine. Scaffold agent-ready storefronts with npx create-cartwright; MCP, voice/vision, JSON-LD, no SaaS lock-in.

paragraphs: A real site with design — and, when you want them, database and backend — live in minutes, and you own every line of code. No SaaS lock-in, no per-order fees, no platform tax. Cartwright is an open-source site + commerce + AI engine built on Next.js 16 and React 19 — with Prisma, Stripe and the Model Context Protocol in the database-backed profiles.
MCP server (/api/mcp) and a JSON tool catalogue (/api/v1/tools) ship in the box.
sitemap.xml, .well-known/ucp + mcp.json, and an AI-crawler-friendly robots.txt.
